看着对方变成利刃的双手，爻雪淡定地说道：“金属性异能的分支，能够将身体部位幻化成各种冷兵器，非常强力的战斗异能。”

说完，她的手里不知道什么时候多出了一张卡牌。

“这是身份卡，拿着吧，”

刚刚觉醒的吴岳看着递过来的身份卡，又看了看自己变成双刃的双手，一时之间不知道自己该如何去接。

见状，爻雪就知道他如今还不能控制自己的异能，说道：“屏气凝神，那是你的双手，即便是变成了利刃也依旧是你的手，你对双手的控制权应该并没有消失吧。”

听到爻雪这样说，吴岳闭上眼睛动了动，下一秒，原本变成双刃的手臂再次恢复原样。

其他人则是惊喜地看着这一幕，刚刚所发生的一切对于他们而言实在是太过神奇了。

吴岳从爻雪的手中接过身份卡，爱不释手地反复观看，片刻之后问道：“这身份卡有什么作用？”

爻雪说道：“你可以理解为是你在我这里的会员卡，只有持有会员卡的人才有资格在我的店里消费。”

“你还有店！”

爻雪看向说话的人，翻了个白眼说道：“那是自然，我是NPC又不是流浪商人，当然有店了，不过我的店距离你们这边应该很远，你们过不去，所以我才过来。通过这张身份卡，你们也可以联系我，当然，我不一定会回应。。

店铺里面的商品目录也会在上面更新，晶核能够换取积分，积分的数量会在身份卡上面显示，其中也包括你们刚刚兑换获得的积分。

从系统那边得知，这身份卡还有很多的用处，只不过是因为她如今等级不够，所以都无法解锁，只能够当做最普通的身份证使用。

听完爻雪的介绍之后，其他人对于觉醒异能的热情变得更加高涨了，他们现在恨不得立刻也觉醒异能。

吴岳作为刚刚觉醒了异能的人，理所当然地冲在了最前面，对于自身异能的使用，他从最开始的磕磕绊绊，很快就用的炉火纯青了。

Looking at the opponent's hands turned into sharp blades, Yaoxue said calmly: "The branch of metallic power can transform body parts into various cold weapons, a very powerful combat power."

After saying that, she didn't know when an extra card appeared in her hand.

"This is the ID card, take it,"

Wu Yue, who had just awakened, looked at the identity card handed over to him, and then at his hands that had turned into double blades. He didn't know how to take it for a moment.

Seeing this, Yaoxue knew that he still couldn't control his powers, and said: "Hold your breath and concentrate, those are your hands. Even if they become sharp blades, they are still your hands. Your control over your hands should not disappear."

Hearing what Yaoxue said, Wu Yue closed his eyes and moved. The next second, the arm that had turned into a double-edged sword returned to its original state.

Others looked at this scene in surprise. What just happened was too magical for them.

Wu Yue took the ID card from Yao Xue's hand and couldn't put it down and watched it over and over again. After a moment, he asked, "What is the purpose of this ID card?"

Yaoxue said: "You can understand it as your membership card with me. Only those who hold the membership card are eligible to spend money in my store."

"You still have a store!"

Yaoxue looked at the person who spoke, rolled her eyes and said, "That's natural. I'm an NPC and not a wandering merchant. Of course I have a store, but my store should be far away from you and you can't get there, so I came here. Through this identity card, you can also contact me. Of course, I may not respond."

The product catalog in the store will also be updated on it. Crystal cores can be exchanged for points. The number of points will be displayed on the ID card, including the points you just redeemed.

I learned from the system that this ID card has many uses, but because she is not at a high level now, it cannot be unlocked and can only be used as the most common ID card.

After listening to Yaoxue's introduction, other people's enthusiasm for awakening superpowers became even higher. They now wanted to awaken their superpowers immediately.

As a person who had just awakened his superpower, Wu Yue naturally rushed to the front. Regarding the use of his superpower, he stumbled at the beginning and soon became proficient in using it.
